scripts.predev: npm run build -w @agentrail/core && npm run build -w @agentrail/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @agentrail/server" "npm run dev -w @agentrail/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentrail/core && npm run build -w @agentrail/server && npm run build -w @agentrail/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @agentrail/core && npm run build -w @agentrail/server && npm run migrate -w @agentrail/server
scripts.demo:seed: npm run build -w @agentrail/core && npm run build -w @agentrail/server && npm run seed -w @agentrail/server
